Subject: GCP spotlight demo — possible slot swap?

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for coordinating the joint GCP marketplace showcase. We just heard from our SI (CloudSmith) that their lead engineer has a mandatory customer engagement on the 10th, which conflicts with the current dry-run on Mar 10 at 10:00 PT.

Would Redwood be able to swap the internal dry-run slot to Mar 9 (same window: 10:00–11:00 PT) so CloudSmith can still do the combined rehearsal on Mar 10 with the client? If we can’t move, they asked whether we have an immediate contingency block (30–45 minutes) later that day to cover the SI walkthrough only.

Attaching a short runbook and the marketplace checklist — they flagged a couple of technical gating items (service account scope & regional image access) that we should pre-verify.

Appreciate a quick confirmation — our timelines are tight for the launch.

Best,
Anna
Partner Programs | Echolight Labs

Attachments: echolight-runbook-v1.pdf, gcp-marketplace-checklist.xlsx

Hi Anna — thanks for the heads up and for sending the runbook.

Quick reply: we can likely move the internal dry-run to Mar 9 10:00–11:00 PT, but I need to confirm a couple of constraints:
- Kim is the primary ops owner for the marketplace listing test; I’ll check her availability and our staging infra reservations.
- We should hold a 30-minute contingency block on Mar 10 at 14:00 PT in case CloudSmith needs to do an SI-only walkthrough after their client meeting (you mentioned 30–45 mins).

Two asks from our side:
1) Can CloudSmith confirm the exact time their client meeting ends (so we can schedule the contingency block accurately)?
2) Anna — can Echolight share the service account scope that needs verification so our infra team can pre-check tonight?

If Kim is out, we’ll nominate Irene as backup. I’ll follow up in ~1 hour after I confirm the calendar and infra slots.

Thanks,
Jonas
